summary: StageWise Strategies Corp. (now TEG Overseas, Inc.) reported closing on October 13, 2026 of a share exchange in which it acquired 99.99999012% of TEG SPV LLC from TEG Parent (67.99999012%) and individual seller Irodakhon Abduvakhitova (32.0%). The company issued 183,098,434 shares of common stock, 124,506,935 to TEG Parent and 58,591,499 to the individual seller, representing about 97.3% of the 188,142,768 post-transaction shares outstanding. No cash price or premium was disclosed. The filing also amended the charter and made management changes, but no board recommendation or advisor is named.
